artworks.title: Saint Jerome Standing Under an Arch
artworks.description: This print features a man depicted in a full-length pose. He is standing in a slightly crouched position, facing left and leaning forward against an arched stone doorway with his ankles crossed. His right hand is slightly outstretched and appears to hold a small round object, while his left hand holds a cross. A large book is held under his left arm. The man has a large forehead, a sharp nose, prominent cheekbones, and a bushy, flowing beard and mustache. He is attired in a loose, knee-length garment, revealing muscular arms and legs, and he is barefoot. There is a halo-like outline around his head. In the background beyond the arched doorway, buildings can be seen from above which feature towers, arches, and a tall spire. A small, lion-like animal is visible outside beneath one of the arches. Next to the man, there is an object resembling a plaque or stone with inscriptions on the ground. The print is monochromatic, with dark lines against a white background.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome with the Angel
artworks.description: The image shows two figures, an elderly man and a younger figure with wings, seated opposite each other. The elderly man is seated to the left, with his full body visible except for his feet. He has a long beard, a bald head with a halo around it, and is wearing a tunic that reveals his muscular arms and legs. The younger figure is kneeling on the right, dressed in flowing robes with voluminous sleeves, and has short curly hair. This figure has wings emerging from their back. The younger figure is holding the elderly man's hand, and they appear to be engaged in a discussion or exchange. Above them, there is a tablet with the date "1521" and the initials "I SP." The background shows a textured wall with some natural elements like branches or plants visible.

artworks.title: Saint Anthony the Hermit
artworks.description: The image shows a figure sitting with the upper body prominently displayed, looking upwards. The person is positioned with their right arm resting on an open book or tablet, and their left hand holding a writing instrument. The face is detailed with pronounced features, including a broad forehead and slightly opened mouth, and the hair is mostly covered by a circular halo. The attire is a flowing, draped garment with a visible belt and rolled sleeves, and the figure appears to be barefoot. Behind the figure, there is a tree or post with a small crucified figure, indicating a backdrop of hilly terrain. In the foreground, a pair of crossed keys and a fallen cup are depicted. The background consists of densely shaded hills and foliage.

artworks.title: Saint Sebald
artworks.description: The image shows a full-bodied figure seated under a tree, with a mountainous landscape in the background. The person is seated with one leg bent and the other stretched, holding a long staff in his right hand and a model of a church with twin towers in his left hand. The facial features are detailed, showcasing a bushy beard and a tranquil expression. The hair is mostly obscured beneath a cap featuring religious symbols, and there is a halo surrounding his head. The person is dressed in a flowing robe with a cloak fastened by a decorative clasp. The background includes a stylized depiction of hills and a castle-like structure in the distance.

artworks.title: Greeks and Trojans
artworks.description: The drawing shows a battle scene with warriors fighting fantastical creatures. The warriors are armed with spears and shields, engaged in combat with centaur-like beings. The composition is dense, depicting chaos with rearing horses and fallen figures. Detailed line work and cross-hatching convey movement and energy of the scene.

artworks.title: The Abduction of Helena
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting a chaotic scene with multiple figures in motion. The figures are engaged in a struggle, some holding weapons like spears and shields. The composition includes standing and fallen figures, creating depth and movement. There are inscriptions above the figures. The detailed musculature of the figures emphasizes the dramatic nature of the scene, and the shading adds intensity to the background.

artworks.title: The Death of Regulus
artworks.description: This is an illustration of a group of figures interacting with a barrel while one figure rides a horse. The image shows multiple figures with one riding a horse and others manipulating a large barrel. The figures are intricately detailed with various textures and lines. Surrounding the circle are decorative elements like leaves or floral motifs. The image uses contrast and shadow to create depth and dimension. The craftsmanship suggests a traditional scene with a focus on storytelling through expressive poses and interactions.

artworks.title: Cimon and Pero
artworks.description: The image shows two figures seated closely together in an architectural setting with arches. The man's body is mostly visible; he is sitting on a bench, leaning slightly to the side, with one leg bent at the knee and the other extended, his head tilted upward towards the woman. He has long, curly hair and a beard, partially covered by a cap. He wears a draped garment that wraps around his waist, with an ornamental band across the chest and arms exposed. The woman is standing close to him, leaning slightly over, causing her body to also be largely visible. She has long hair, styled and possibly tied back, and her facial expression is focused on the man. Her attire is a draped cloth that covers the lower part of her body, with her upper torso mostly bare, and appears to be fastened around her arms. In the background, the setting features a detailed archway with bricks visible and two shield-like circular designs on the wall beneath the arch.

artworks.title: Cleopatra Standing
artworks.description: The image shows a standing nude woman with a serpent coiled around her arm. She is facing slightly to the left, with her left arm raised. The woman's head is turned to the left, her eyes are focused on the snake, and her mouth is open. She has classical features, including a prominent nose and lips, with curly hair reaching her shoulders. In the background, there is a dark area with a faintly etched "CLEOPATRA" on a rectangular frame. On the right side are circular objects and a fabric piece marked with "1529 RDP." At the lower left is a plain vase, with a chain attached to the frame.

artworks.title: Cleopatra Seated
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated with legs crossed and one arm on their lap, head tilted slightly to the left. They have curly, shoulder-length hair and soft facial features. The person wears a robe that drapes over one shoulder, leaving the other bare, with a sash tied at the waist. A serpent is wrapped around their arm and hand. The setting is a sparsely decorated room with bars on a window, chains on the ground, and walls with what seems to be an empty circular window or vent. The overall composition is detailed, resembling an etching or engraved artwork.

artworks.title: Lucretia Standing
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with a dagger in their right hand, poised towards their chest. They have a calm expression with eyes closed, curly hair, and are partially draped in fabric. They are barefoot near a pedestal with engraved text, set against an architectural background with stone-like structures.

artworks.title: Dido
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 11.9  x  9.1 cm (4  11/16 x 3 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person seated on a stone or raised surface, with their upper body leaning slightly forward. Their head is bowed, facing slightly downwards. The person has short, wavy hair adorned with a laurel wreath and is unclothed, displaying muscular arms and torso. A cloth is draped around their lower body, partially covering their legs. They are holding a sword, with the blade resting on their thigh. The background includes rocky surfaces and a textual inscription on a plaque to the right, which appears to be in Latin. The environment has an ancient or historical aesthetic, with a rough foreground composed of gravel or stones.

artworks.title: The Justice of Trajan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of Roman soldiers, a noble figure on a horse, and a distressed woman. The soldiers are clustered in a group with some on horseback. A noble figure on a horse is approached by a woman gesturing. Soldiers with spears and shields surround them. The drawing features intricate detailing in the clothing, armor, and expressions. The text above and between the figures suggests a classical or historical context. The composition is well-balanced, focusing on the interaction between the central figures amidst a background of soldiers and a statue.

artworks.title: The Justice of Trajan
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a historical scene involving soldiers, a horse, and an interaction. The image shows a group of armored soldiers, with one mounted on a horse, engaging with a woman and a child. The scene is detailed, featuring spears, helmets, and precise depictions of facial expressions and clothing folds. An inscription in Latin is included in the drawing. The artist portrays the dynamics of a historical narrative, evoking drama and authority.

artworks.title: Moses and Aaron
artworks.description: The image features two figures, Moses and Aaron, depicted from the waist up. Moses is turned slightly to the left, while Aaron is to the right. Moses has a long beard and a stern expression, wearing a robe and resting his hand on a book. Aaron also has a beard and wears a helmet with an inscription, with his hand on the book. Behind them is a stone tablet symbolizing the Ten Commandments, with the names "MOSE" and "AARON" above their heads. The background shows a hilly landscape with mountains and buildings, suggesting a historical or biblical setting. The image is dated 1526 with a monogram in the top right corner.

artworks.title: The Hour of Death
artworks.description: This image depicts a skeleton with an unclothed figure in an ornately decorated room. The unclothed figure is seated, pulling back a curtain. The skeleton holds an hourglass and a spade. The room has detailed furnishings and decorations, including a tapestry-covered bed.

artworks.title: Convoi Funèbre au Boulevard de Clichy (Funeral Procession on the Boulevard de Clichy)
artworks.medium: heliogravure, etching, aquatint, and drypoint with burnishing in blue-green and brown-black on toned wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with a horse-drawn carriage in the foreground. The road is busy with figures, carriages, and horses. Buildings line both sides of the street, leading to the horizon in the upper third of the image. The style features loose brushstrokes or etching lines to convey movement. The color palette is muted, with tones of sepia, blue, and black suggesting a nighttime or dusk setting. A moon is visible in the sky, surrounded by clouds.

artworks.title: La Maison Maudite (The House of the Damned)
artworks.description: The image depicts a central rectangular scene surrounded by abstract shapes and lines as a border. At the top of the scene, several owls are perched on a branch. In the main rectangular scene, figures are shown in motion on a cobblestone street with trees in the background. One figure is holding a stick or broom. Below, the words "L'EN SORGELE" are integrated into the composition. The scene includes abstract and whimsical figures, including smudges, swirls, cats, and flowing costumes.

artworks.title: La Place Pigalle en 1878 (Place Pigalle in 1878)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, and roulette in black on toned paper
artworks.description: The image shows a busy urban scene viewed from street level, including people and horses. The horizon is not distinct due to the dense architectural elements and figures. On the right, people are seen sitting on steps, with two individuals holding an umbrella. The brushstrokes are dynamic, capturing movement, and the color palette mainly consists of sepia and beige. In the distance, intricate buildings and a staircase can be seen blending into the background with the same hurried linework.

artworks.title: La Place des Martyrs et La Taverne du Bagne (The Place des Martyrs and the Jailhouse Tavern)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, lift-ground aquatint, and drypoint in blue-black on brown laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a street scene with densely packed buildings from a slightly elevated perspective. A sign for "Taverne du Bagne" is prominently displayed on a building to the center-right. The etching technique shows fine, detailed line work depicting architecture and a lively crowd. The color palette is monochromatic with an ochre tint, giving the image an aged and atmospheric quality. People are gathered near us, some in conversation or walking, while buildings fill the background. Small sketches of figures and inscriptions are seen on the borders.

artworks.title: La Traversée (The Passage)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, roulette, aquatint and stop-out in black on brown laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a collage of maritime and rainy weather scenes. The drawing is a collection of intricate sketches depicting varied scenes set on a ship. There are travelers on the deck with umbrellas in the upper right, a rainy scene with a dog and figures in the top left, and a staircase on the deck center. Nautical elements like sails or masts are scattered throughout. The piece captures moments on a sea voyage with an emphasis on the texture of weather elements like rain and clouds.

artworks.title: Une Matinée d'Hiver au Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu (Winter Morning on the Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, stop-out and roulette on japan paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a city street scene with horse-drawn carriages moving along a wet street reflecting the surroundings. In the distance, buildings are visible with smoke rising from chimneys. The brushstrokes are detailed, creating a textured portrayal of the scene with a hazy atmosphere. The color palette is sepia and gray, enhancing the historical vibe. People with umbrellas and a street lamp are also present in the scene.

artworks.title: Une Matinée d'Hiver au Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu (Winter Morning on the Quai de l'Hôtel-Dieu)
artworks.medium: etching, aquatint, drypoint, stop-out, and roulette on heavy wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a wet, reflective street with carriages and pedestrians. The street recedes into the misty distance, creating depth. The brushstrokes are soft and fluid with a sketch-like quality. The palette is monochromatic with various shades of grey. Figures with umbrellas are seen in horse-drawn carriages in the foreground. Building facades line the street, leading to a vanishing point in the distance. Tall buildings on the right have blurred outlines.
